notes.title: Hanzi Match in Steam Store
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hanzi Match will be released in about two weeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384240/

[b]Add the game to your wish list if you like it![/b]


[h3]Features:[/h3]

▪ Endless puzzle levels
▪ 200+ Chinese characters
▪ Click the character to play its pronunciation
▪ Automatically get a new achievement every 60 seconds



There are 100 achievements. Steam gives the game a limit of 100 achievements initially. If the limit increases in the future, I'll add more achievements for it.

You can easily get all the achievement just by opening the game. You'll get a new achievement every 60 seconds.
